description: Explicit SV2 routing for the 49 V8/V9 templates. Output column names were verified by executing V8 and V9 release queries for every template/variant on real data. key columns = all result columns except value_columns, rank_by, and diagnostic_columns.

tpl_cardinality_continuous_range_envelop.rationale: Primary measure is the range width magnitude.

tpl_cardinality_distinct_share_profile.rationale: Support distribution over value labels; share/cumulative columns derive from support.

tpl_cardinality_high_card_response_stabi.rationale: Keyed AVG response per high-cardinality key.

tpl_cardinality_support_rank_profile.rationale: Support distribution over value labels; share/rank derive from support.

tpl_c2_filtered_group_count_2d.rationale: Filtered COUNT(*) over a two-column key.

tpl_c2_two_dim_target_rate.rationale: AVG(CASE ... THEN 1 ELSE 0) target rate per two-column key.

tpl_m4_group_condition_rate.rationale: AVG(CASE ... THEN 1 ELSE 0) condition rate per group.

tpl_m4_group_dispersion_rank.rationale: Keyed dispersion statistic (SQLite rendering outputs measure_variance).

tpl_m4_group_ratio_two_conditions.rationale: Numeric ratio of two condition counts (not bounded to [0, 1]).

tpl_m4_window_partition_avg.rationale: Keyed window AVG (SELECT DISTINCT group, avg).

tpl_rtabench_time_bucket_filtered_count.rationale: Temporal count distribution over time buckets.

tpl_rtabench_time_bucket_group_moving_av.rationale: Temporal count distribution over (time_bucket, group); the moving average derives from event_count.

tpl_tpcds_baseline_gated_extreme_ranking.rationale: Top-k (group, item) identities ordered by avg_measure.

tpl_tpcds_within_group_share.rationale: Within-group share computed as SUM * 100.0 / group total; explicitly declared 0..100 percentage scale.

tpl_missing_target_interaction.rationale: Keyed missingness rate per target value.

tpl_clickbench_filtered_distinct_topk.rationale: Top-k groups by filtered distinct entity count.

tpl_clickbench_filtered_topk_group_count.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed count distribution over the returned groups.

tpl_clickbench_group_distinct_topk.rationale: Top-k groups by distinct entity count.

tpl_clickbench_group_summary_topk.rationale: Top-k groups by support; attached measures are diagnostics.

tpl_clickbench_two_dimensional_topk_coun.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed count distribution over two-column keys.

tpl_h2o_two_dimensional_robust_summary.rationale: Keyed median (the query orders by median); stddev is a diagnostic.

tpl_m4_support_guarded_group_avg.rationale: Keyed AVG with support guard; support is a diagnostic.

tpl_tpcds_topk_group_sum.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed numeric aggregate.

tpl_tpch_max_aggregate_winner.rationale: Argmax winner set; ties return several winners ordered by group, so depth = max list length.

tpl_tpch_two_dimensional_summary.rationale: Keyed AVG (template primary measure); SUM and support are diagnostics.

tpl_h2o_topn_within_group.rationale: Top-n value curve: the semantic target is the value at each within-group rank, keyed by (group_value, measure_rank).

tpl_m4_global_zscore_outliers.rationale: Template primary measure is the global outlier rate.

tpl_m4_quantile_tail_slice.rationale: Template primary measure is the mean of the top-quantile tail slice.

tpl_tail_low_support_group_count_v2.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed count distribution over the returned tail groups.

tpl_tail_pairwise_sparse_slice_v2.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed count distribution over sparse pairs.

tpl_tail_target_rate_extremes_v2.rationale: Template contract declares a keyed rate profile.

tpl_tpcds_subgroup_baseline_outlier.rationale: Keyed (group, item) entity SUM above the subgroup baseline.

tpl_tpch_relative_total_threshold.rationale: Ranked groups above a share-of-total threshold (no LIMIT).

tpl_tpch_thresholded_group_ranking.rationale: Top-k groups by total above a threshold.
